input.command: set -a; . ./.env.ops; set +a; psql "$LEDGER_REPLICA_URL" -Atc "with b as (select timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q3, timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q4), start as (select count(*) n from customers, b where created_at < q3 and (cancelled_at is null or cancelled_at >= q3)), lost as (select count(*) n from customers, b where cancelled_at >= q3 and cancelled_at < q4 and created_at < q3) select start.n, lost.n, round(100.0 * lost.n / start.n, 2) from start, lost"; psql "$LEDGER_REPLICA_URL" -Atc "with b as (select timestamptz '2026-04-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q2, timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q3, timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q4) select to_char(sum(i.amount), 'FM999,999,990.00') from invoices i join customers c on c.id = i.customer_id, b where c.cancelled_at >= q3 and c.cancelled_at < q4 and i.issued_at >= q2 and i.issued_at < q3"

content.text:
Q3 2026, from 2026-07-01 00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin (end exclusive):

- Customers active at the start: 9,873
- Cancelled during Q3: 416
- Churn: 4.21%
- Q2 billing of the customers who churned in Q3: 286,977.40 EUR

```sql
with b as (select timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q3,
                  timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q4),
start as (select count(*) n from customers, b
          where created_at < q3 and (cancelled_at is null or cancelled_at >= q3)),
lost as (select count(*) n from customers, b
         where cancelled_at >= q3 and cancelled_at < q4 and created_at < q3)
select start.n, lost.n, round(100.0 * lost.n / start.n, 2) from start, lost;

with b as (select timestamptz '2026-04-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q2,
                  timestamptz '2026-07-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q3,
                  timestamptz '2026-10-01 00:00 Europe/Berlin' q4)
select sum(i.amount)
from invoices i join customers c on c.id = i.customer_id, b
where c.cancelled_at >= q3 and c.cancelled_at < q4
  and i.issued_at >= q2 and i.issued_at < q3;
```
